title: Bet builders explained: why the price is usually shorter than the odds multiplied

scenes.say: A bet builder is one bet on several things happening in the same match. Every one has to win, and it's priced differently from an accumulator.
scenes.caption: A bet builder is one bet on several things happening in the same match. Every one has to win, and it's priced differently from an accumulator.

visual.title: One match, one price, and every selection has to win

scenes.say: Pick a match. Add selections from different markets: the result, goals, corners, cards, or a player to score. The site shows one price for the whole bet, and you place one stake. If any selection loses, the whole bet loses.
scenes.caption: Pick a match. Add selections from different markets: the result, goals, corners, cards, or a player to score. The site shows one price for the whole bet, and you place one stake. If any selection loses, the whole bet loses.

scenes.say: In an accumulator, the selections come from different events, so the odds simply multiply. In a bet builder, they affect each other. If a team's striker scores, that team is more likely to win.
scenes.caption: In an accumulator, the selections come from different events, so the odds simply multiply. In a bet builder, they affect each other. If a team's striker scores, that team is more likely to win.

visual.heading: Not the same as an accumulator
visual.footer: Striker scores → team more likely to win

scenes.say: Say the team is two to win, and its striker is two and a half to score. Multiplied, that's five. But because the two tend to happen together, the bookmaker prices the pair lower, say at three seventy-five. On ten pounds, that's thirty-seven pounds fifty back if both win, not fifty. These prices are illustrative.
scenes.caption: Say the team is 2.00 to win, and its striker is 2.50 to score. Multiplied, that's 5.00. But because the two tend to happen together, the bookmaker prices the pair lower, say at 3.75. On £10, that's £37.50 back if both win, not £50. These prices are illustrative.

scenes.say: Each extra selection lengthens the price, but it also cuts your chance of winning. A long bet builder pays well because all of its selections rarely win together.
scenes.caption: Each extra selection lengthens the price, but it also cuts your chance of winning. A long bet builder pays well because all of its selections rarely win together.

and a lower chance that all of them win
